summary.en: The Nagoya City disaster-prevention app lets you check risks and evacuation sites by address and sends notices. Safety tips is an app for foreign visitors and residents supervised by the Japan Tourism Agency; it sends earthquake, tsunami and weather warnings in 15 languages. NERV Disaster Prevention is an app from a private company that sends earthquake, tsunami and weather information. You may need to turn on notifications and location. This app (Kurashi) does not send alerts.
